issues.issue: Făraș: An ordinary dustpan/scoop gathering sweepings, consistent with the existing floor-dust object and familiar in both historical DEX/CADE entries and current original Leifheit products. Newly authored dust/crumb collection facts are accepted, but the final graph must actually provide five recognizable incoming neighbors before C3 can pass. Sources independently opened: https://dexonline.ro/definitie/f%C4%83ra%C8%99 ; https://leifheit.ro/ro/13-curatare-uscata .

Aspirator: The served owner explicitly means a household floor/carpet suction appliance. Historical DEX and current original Kärcher products support recognition and the physical device. Dust/crumb/lint collection, carpet care and electric power are factually supported with the review qualifications; electricity is not inferred from the dictionary alone. C3/C4 and final feedback fairness are separate. Sources independently opened: https://dexonline.ro/definitie/aspirator/830471 ; https://www.karcher.com/ro/ro/home-and-garden/produse/aspiratoare-c4250 .

Burete de vase: The qualified label matches the existing soft porous washing object. Historical DEX washing-object sense and original FINO/Vileda/epack dish-sponges support factual identity and longstanding/current familiarity. Bare burete can also mean fungus or sea sponge and is not added as an alias. Plate/water use is supported, but the disclosed legacy Farfurie scorer proxy and overall easy-band journey remain quality questions. Sources independently opened: https://dexonline.ro/definitie/burete ; https://www.fino.eu/ro/produse/curatenie-si-igiena/bureti-de-bucatarie/ .
